WITH appeal_windows AS (
  SELECT 'Medicare' AS payer, 120 AS window_days
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Northstar Advantage', 60
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Medicaid', 90
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Evergreen Health Plan', 180
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Cascade Mutual', 60
  -- Self-pay has no appeal window
),
denied_claims AS (
  SELECT
    c.claim_id,
    c.payer,
    c.adjudicated_date,
    c.billed_amount,
    c.appeal_status,
    aw.window_days
  FROM healthcare_clinical.claims c
  JOIN appeal_windows aw ON c.payer = aw.payer
  WHERE c.denied = 1
    AND c.appeal_status = 'none'
    AND c.adjudicated_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  dc.payer,
  COUNT(*) AS denied_not_appealed_count,
  SUM(dc.billed_amount) AS total_billed_amount_usd
FROM denied_claims dc
WHERE dc.adjudicated_date + INTERVAL (dc.window_days) DAY >= DATE '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY dc.payer
ORDER BY dc.payer;

WITH hf_discharges AS (
    SELECT 
        e.encounter_id,
        e.patient_id,
        e.facility_id,
        f.facility_name,
        e.discharge_ts::date AS discharge_date,
        e.discharge_disposition
    FROM healthcare_clinical.encounters e
    JOIN healthcare_clinical.facilities f ON e.facility_id = f.facility_id
    JOIN healthcare_clinical.diagnoses d ON e.encounter_id = d.encounter_id
    WHERE e.encounter_type = 'inpatient'
      AND e.discharge_ts >= '2026-08-01' 
      AND e.discharge_ts < '2026-09-01'
      AND d.is_primary = 1
      AND d.icd10_code LIKE 'I50.%'
      AND e.discharge_disposition IN ('home', 'home_health')
),
followup_visits AS (
    SELECT 
        e.patient_id,
        e.admit_ts::date AS followup_date,
        e.encounter_id AS followup_encounter_id
    FROM healthcare_clinical.encounters e
    WHERE e.encounter_type = 'outpatient'
      AND e.visit_reason = 'post_discharge_followup'
      AND e.admit_ts >= '2026-08-01'
      AND e.admit_ts < '2026-10-01'
)
SELECT 
    hfd.patient_id,
    hfd.facility_name AS hospital,
    hfd.discharge_date,
    hfd.discharge_disposition,
    fv.followup_date,
    CASE 
        WHEN fv.followup_date IS NOT NULL 
             AND fv.followup_date <= hfd.discharge_date + INTERVAL '7 days'
        THEN 'Completed within 7 days'
        WHEN fv.followup_date IS NOT NULL
        THEN 'Completed after 7 days'
        ELSE 'No follow-up found'
    END AS followup_status
FROM hf_discharges hfd
LEFT JOIN followup_visits fv ON hfd.patient_id = fv.patient_id
    AND fv.followup_date > hfd.discharge_date
    AND fv.followup_date <= hfd.discharge_date + INTERVAL '30 days'
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hfd.encounter_id ORDER BY fv.followup_date) = 1
ORDER BY hfd.discharge_date, hfd.patient_id;

WITH hospitals AS (
  SELECT facility_id, facility_name
  FROM healthcare_clinical.facilities
  WHERE facility_type = 'hospital'
)
SELECT
  r.facility_id,
  h.facility_name,
  SUM(r.index_discharges) AS total_index_discharges,
  SUM(r.readmissions_30d) AS total_readmissions,
  ROUND(SUM(r.readmissions_30d) / SUM(r.index_discharges) * 100, 1) AS quarterly_readmission_rate_pct
FROM healthcare_clinical.quality_scorecard_readmissions r
JOIN hospitals h ON r.facility_id = h.facility_id
WHERE r.month >= '2026-04-01' AND r.month <= '2026-06-30'
  AND r.cohort = 'All-cause'
GROUP BY r.facility_id, h.facility_name
ORDER BY r.facility_id;

WITH hospitals AS (
  SELECT facility_id, facility_name
  FROM healthcare_clinical.facilities
  WHERE facility_type = 'hospital'
)
SELECT
  r.facility_id,
  h.facility_name,
  r.month,
  r.cohort,
  r.index_discharges,
  r.readmissions_30d,
  r.readmission_rate_pct,
  r.target_rate_pct
FROM healthcare_clinical.quality_scorecard_readmissions r
JOIN hospitals h ON r.facility_id = h.facility_id
WHERE r.month >= '2026-04-01' AND r.month <= '2026-06-30'
  AND r.cohort = 'All-cause'
ORDER BY r.facility_id, r.month;
